title: Complete DP adversarial and targeted-revision safety

checks.name: visibility_leak_cases
checks.result: Deterministic DP review detects visible-surface, audio-only, occluded-state, timed-visibility, reflection-path, undeclared rear/UI surface, payload-route and human-QA-only leaks. Positive closure is required; findings are bound to current objects and remain TEXT_VALIDATED only.

checks.name: fresh_dp
checks.result: A DP packet has a strictly whitelisted, integrity-checked view plus a unique context and manifest. Cache records bind the view and revision identity; a revision cannot reuse its prior context or prior response as fresh review evidence.

checks.name: no_redirection
checks.result: DP output may report observable, scope-bound questions but cannot select camera or cut answers, mandate a focal length/motion/shot count, replace the Director, or request a whole-scene rewrite. The router retains the same Director identity.

checks.name: targeted_scope_only
checks.result: Only DIRECTED_QUESTION issues may produce revisions. Scope derives from DP-bound objects and directly adjacent boundaries; frozen segments, Input Block, unrelated scope and changed untouched hashes fail closed. A valid revision requires PRECHECK, DERIVE and a fresh DP context.

compatibility.media_acceptance_claim: not made; DP is TEXT_VALIDATED only
compatibility.director_creative_semantics: not implemented in R2.4; actual Director Phase B and VEC remain later controlled work packages
